attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kansas corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ks_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ks_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KS requires addback of federal interest income and state income tax refunds, with subtraction of Kansas municipal bond interest.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set ks_result.state_additions = 0.0; if ks_result.us_interest_income != 0.0 then set ks_result.state_additions = ks_result.state_additions + ks_result.us_interest_income; endif if ks_result.state_tax_refunds != 0.0 then set ks_result.state_additions = ks_result.state_additions + ks_result.state_tax_refunds; endif set ks_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if ks_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set ks_result.state_subtractions = ks_result.state_subtractions + ks_result.municipal_interest; endif if ks_result.state_taxes_paid != 0.0 then set ks_result.state_subtractions = ks_result.state_subtractions + ks_result.state_taxes_paid; endif add (("Kansas additions: $" + string value of (ks_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (ks_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /ks_result.state_additions xdef { ks_result.state_additions ks_result.us_interest_income f+ cvd /ks_result.state_additions xdef } {} ks_result.us_interest_income 0.0 f!= ifelse { ks_result.state_additions ks_result.state_tax_refunds f+ cvd /ks_result.state_additions xdef } {} ks_result.state_tax_refunds 0.0 f!= ifelse 0.0 cvd /ks_result.state_subtractions xdef { ks_result.state_subtractions ks_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /ks_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ks_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f!= ifelse { ks_result.state_subtractions ks_result.state_taxes_paid f+ cvd /ks_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ks_result.state_taxes_paid 0.0 f!= ifelse "Kansas additions: $" ks_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat ks_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas corporate income tax. Applies Kansas two-tier rate (4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ks_apportioned_income is greater than 0
Income exceeds $50,000 surtax threshold; result.ks_taxable_income is greater than result.ks_surtax_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax with base rate + surtax (income over $50K); Apply 4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K
action_details.action_dsl: set ks_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ks_result.apportioned_income + ks_result.state_additions - ks_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ks_result.base_tax = ks_result.taxable_income * ks_result.corp_tax_base_rate; set ks_result.surtax = (ks_result.taxable_income - ks_result.surtax_threshold) * ks_result.corp_tax_surtax_rate; set ks_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ks_result.base_tax + ks_result.surtax - ks_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ks_result.refund_or_owed = ks_result.estimated_payments - ks_result.tax_liability; add "Kansas taxable income: $" + string value of (ks_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas base tax (4.0%): $" + string value of (ks_result.base_tax) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas surtax (3.0% on excess over $50K): $" + string value of (ks_result.surtax) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas tax liability: $" + string value of (ks_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ks_result.apportioned_income ks_result.state_additions f+ ks_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ks_result.taxable_income xdef ks_result.taxable_income ks_result.corp_tax_base_rate fmul cvd /ks_result.base_tax xdef ks_result.taxable_income ks_result.surtax_threshold f- ks_result.corp_tax_surtax_rate fmul cvd /ks_result.surtax xdef ks_result.base_tax ks_result.surtax f+ ks_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ks_result.tax_liability xdef ks_result.estimated_payments ks_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ks_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas taxable income: $" ks_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas base tax (4.0%): $" ks_result.base_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas surtax (3.0% on excess over $50K): $" ks_result.surtax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability: $" ks_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax - income $50K or less (base rate only); Apply only 4.0% base rate
action_details.action_dsl: set ks_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ks_result.apportioned_income + ks_result.state_additions - ks_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ks_result.base_tax = ks_result.taxable_income * ks_result.corp_tax_base_rate; set ks_result.surtax = 0.0; set ks_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ks_result.base_tax - ks_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ks_result.refund_or_owed = ks_result.estimated_payments - ks_result.tax_liability; add "Kansas taxable income: $" + string value of (ks_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kansas tax liability (4.0%): $" + string value of (ks_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ks_result.apportioned_income ks_result.state_additions f+ ks_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ks_result.taxable_income xdef ks_result.taxable_income ks_result.corp_tax_base_rate fmul cvd /ks_result.base_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /ks_result.surtax xdef ks_result.base_tax ks_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ks_result.tax_liability xdef ks_result.estimated_payments ks_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ks_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas taxable income: $" ks_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kansas tax liability (4.0%): $" ks_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
